name: Abode Mooloolaba
description:
Near the River Esplanade, this lively, colourful hostel is a 7-minute walk from the UnderWater World Sea Life Aquarium and 11 minutes from Mooloolaba beach.
Simple, dorm-style rooms are mixed or female, with shared or en suite bathrooms. Upgraded rooms are private. Wi-Fi is available; fees may apply. Guests 18 and older are welcome.
Free perks include breakfast and weekly BBQs. Other amenities consist of shared kitchens, a pizza oven, and a TV lounge with a pool table, plus an outdoor pool with a terrace and grills. There are also laundry facilities and balconies, as well as surfing, biking and paddle-boarding.
